decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, dated 19/03/13; received 02/08/13; M/52/V/1/A (S-1/A), dated 01/08/13, received 02/08/13; M/52/V/1/A (S-2/A), dated 01/08/13, received 20/09/13; and M/52/V/1/A (S-3/A), dated 01/08/13, received 02/08/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room, erection of a first floor side extension and a single storey rear extension
